item.title: OpenAI announces slowing pace of development after hack by rogue agent
item.summary: Amid heated race with Anthropic, firm says it’s overhauling research and training and will require greater safety parameters of AI after hack OpenAI on ⁠Tuesday said it had slowed down the ⁠pace of ⁠its ​AI development while it overhauled its ⁠research and training systems. The company’s researchers were ⁠caught unaware last month ​when an ‌AI agent ‌under testing hacked another AI ‌firm, Hugging Face. Continue reading...
